name: runnroll
description: Route planning for running, walking, cycling and skating across Victoria, Australia.

scripts.data:refresh: npm run data:download && npm run data:import && npm run osm:download && npm run osm:load && npm run osm:build
scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend & wait
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
